svg.title: Open-H3-Regenerate-2K pipeline
svg.desc: A low-resolution draft is prepared to 24 fps and 1024 by 576. A video VAE encodes it to a 24 by 37 by 36 by 64 latent. H3-Latent-Upscaler maps it to 24 by 37 by 90 by 160. The latent is mixed with noise at sigma 0.909 and regenerated by the H3 transformer with refiner, turbo and sharp adapters over three Euler steps. The video VAE decodes the result to 2560 by 1440, 121 frames at 24 fps.
svg.text: A · PREPARE AND ENCODE (once per clip)
B · REGENERATE ON THE 2560 × 1440 LATENT GRID
frozen base weights · adapters merged once
σ: 0.909 → 0.857 → 0.667 → 0 · update x ← x + (σ − σ′) · v · model time t = 1 − σ
